name: Ross Stores, Inc.
business: Off-price apparel and home retailer (Ross Dress for Less, dd's DISCOUNTS).

news.title: Q2 sales $6.27B (+13%), comps +10%; FY EPS guide raised to $8.61–8.77; 115 new stores planned
Consensus 'Moderate Buy'; several targets raised (e.g. Truist $310)

pros: Large cash pile: {cash} cash vs {debt} total debt ({src})
ROE {roe}; off-price wins in a cautious consumer environment
cons: Q2 EPS included ~$0.60 tariff refunds — not recurring
H2 comps guided lower (6–7% Q3, 4–5% Q4)
take: Fundamentally strong retailer with momentum; the one-off tariff boost and a full multiple are the caveats.

metrics.summary: Ross Stores, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates off-price retail apparel and home fashion stores under the Ross Dress for Less and dd's DISCOUNTS brands in the United States. The company offers designer apparel, accessories, footwear, and home-fashioned products for the entire family. It sells its products to middle income households and households with lower to more moderate incomes.
